_**Agent (default)**_

A manual Live Audio dropdown pick is now saved by **device name** and restored on the next launch.

- First launch with no saved preference still uses the C920 factory default.
- A user pick (including `"Default"`) is written to gitignored `live_audio_settings.json` and matched by name, not PortAudio index.
- If that named device is gone, it falls back to C920, then OS Default.

Restart the logger after you choose a mic once; later launches will reuse that same input.
